The owners of the TT brand would like to develop a new variety to expand the product 15
portfolio. This new variety would be targeted at parents as a lunchtime snack for their children.
The Marketing Director has been told to do some market research into potential new varieties
A large supermarket group would like to start a joint venture with TT. The supermarket wants
to buy TT’s vegetable chips, but branded with the supermarket packaging. If the directors of 20
TT agree, this is expected to increase TT’s annual sales by 25% and improve the cash flow
of the business. However, the joint venture would mean TT’s profit margin for supermarket
branded chips would be lower than TT’s branded chips. The manager at the factory where
TT’s vegetable chips are produced also has other concerns about the joint venture.
